newsitem.title: UK: Barclays has no comment custody business.
newsitem.headline: Barclays has no comment custody business.

text.p: A spokesman for Barlclays Bank Plc declined to comment on a newspaper report that the bank is in negotiations to sell its global custody business to U.S. investment bank Morgan Stanley.
"It's pure speculation and we never discuss any issues of this kind," Barclays spokesman Jeffery Manton told Reuters.
The Sunday Telegraph said an announcemnt of a deal was expected shortly. It said Barclay's global custody business handles funds worth about 200 billion stg.

"Martin Taylor, Barclays chief executive has decided the custody business with its wafer-thin margins, high compliance costs and remorseless hunger for technology spending is not a core business," the newspaper said.
It said the move would make Morgan Stanley one of the largest custodians in the world, in a business that is rapidly consolidating.
